verdicts.quote: ease off the hills and keep your runs short and flat so that knee can settle down
verdicts.why: Gives training-change advice for the reported knee pain and never says the coach will contact her.
No weight target, weight gain framing, or food-as-earning language.
Warm, specific to her week, starts and ends with names, no guilt.
Days, sleep, steps and workout details match member_week; no fabricated events.
